point3_theNewSpelling.whatTheTextMaskerCanOutput: Each run of letters becomes X, x or the Devanagari letter a, unless it is already only X, x, D or that letter, or (under a header that is not personal) a listed safe word, or m, ft, yd or B followed by D. Digits become D. Everything else is copied (packages/server/src/modules/usp/ingestion/column-profile.ts:64-74). The word 'cell' is none of these, so no real cell text can leave the masker as one of the four forms: a real cell '(blank cell)' leaves as '(blank xxxx)', and under a personal header as '(xxxxx xxxx)' (run with synthetic input).
point3_theNewSpelling.atomic: The forms are written by the builder after masking and after the cut; they are at most 13 characters and never pass through shortenMaskedSample.
point3_theNewSpelling.minimizer: each of the four forms passes unchanged (run with synthetic input); [null] is unchanged and passes as JSON.
